mapper.select: /* ReqInboxMapper.selectProcessedLeaveApprovals */ SELECT AP.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.USER_CD AS userCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.USER_CD, null) AS userNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', R.SITE_CD, COALESCE(NULLIF(R.NODE_CD, ''), ( SELECT RU.NODE_CD FROM TB_USER RU WHERE RU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND RU.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD AND RU.USER_CD = R.USER_CD LIMIT 1 ))) AS nodeNm , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , R.START_DATE AS startDate , R.START_TIME AS startTime , R.END_DATE AS endDate , R.END_TIME AS endTime , COALESCE(LT.LEAVE_NM, R.LEAVE_TYPE) AS leaveTypeNm , R.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', U.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , NULL AS schNo , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS reqDate , AP.APPROVAL_STATUS AS procStatus , DATE_FORMAT(AP.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS processDate , AP.APPROVAL_COMMENT AS processComment , AP.APPROVAL_STEP AS approvalStep , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (R.REQ_TYPE = '05' AND U.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND U.LEAVE_ID = ( SELECT MIN(X.LEAVE_ID) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' )) OR (R.REQ_TYPE = '06' AND U.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ) LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD WHERE AP.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AP.APPROVER_USER_CD = #{approverUserCd} AND AP.APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('02', '03') AND R.REQ_TYPE IN ('05', '06') AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY AP.APPROVAL_DATE DESC, AP.REQ_ID DESC LIMIT 300
